d: Designers give everything they've got for a chance to make a collection for New York Fashion Week.
The final four designers prepare for the runway show at New York Fashion Week.

Fourteen of the most popular designers from Project Runway descend on New York to try for the coveted title that has eluded them. But the fun and games end when judge Nina Garcia and Christian Siriano arrive to give them an unwanted history lesson…

For their very first challenge of the competition, the designers must change history by reinventing the look that either got them eliminated or received the lowest score of their original season, and turn it into a high-fashion moment.

It's neither fun nor games as designers must tackle the Unconventional Materials Challenge. The fur begins to fly as the All-Stars are tasked with creating whimsical runway looks using toys from New York City's most iconic toy store – FAO Schwarz.

It's the first dreaded team challenge of the season and the designers are heading to the ball because it's coronation day! The designers are blindly paired together and tasked with creating couture, modern gowns that exemplify royalty.

The designers are forced to share a single bolt of fabric to demonstrate how they can stand out from each other. Tensions run high as the designers question Anna's creative effort and the drama comes to a head after the challenge.

The style trends of the 1990s are flooding runways. In this challenge, the designers must create chic, cohesive mini-collections inspired by the ‘90s. Designers will take to the halls of an iconic New York City high school to showcase their styles.
